title: WebCartAdjustmentBasis - Data API
description: Coupons that trigger promotions for the cart. When a customer tries to add a coupon to the cart, the store looks for promotions associated with the coupon. If a promotion results in a price adjustment, a WebCartAdjusmentBasis record is created. This object is available in API version 54.0 and later.

AdjustmentBasisDetail.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AdjustmentBasisDetail.description: Coupon code for the coupon associated with the promotion.

AdjustmentBasisReferenceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AdjustmentBasisReferenceId.description: Foreign key reference to the coupon. This field is a relationship field.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The currency ISO code of the cart. Possible values are: EUR USD The default value is USD.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

WebCartId.description: ID of the cart. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: This object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **WebCartAdjustmentBasisChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
